items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: I think I played only one job with him... I think we played a parade one day... and Jack played bass drum.

ctx.x: Do you remember much about your brother playing down here? Did you get to hear him very much with other bands other than Nick LaRocca and that group?
Well, he played with different bands, yeah. He played with Jack Lane and Larry.
